title: Recreated an old favorite of mine
author: QNTLTNQ
selftext:
I really missed an old iOS puzzle game that vanished from the App Store so I asked AI to help me rebuild it. It took about a day of prompting, and I’m super happy with the result!

  
You drag and merge floating numbered shapes to hit exactly 7 to score points, but going over 7 is instant Game Over. It features various power-ups (like multipliers and shufflers) and a local highscore list. The game is 100% offline with no ads or microtransactions.

I have a working Android .apk ready. Before I put it on the Play Store for a symbolic price of 10 cents, I’d love to know: does this look like something you'd play?
